current_behavior: Each variant has a required wigStyleId FK to one style.
failure_example: A variant cannot exist without a parent style.
current_test_evidence: Catalog/payment factories and queries rely on relation.
required_future_contract: Preserve the canonical FK as identity authority.

current_behavior: Listing unit is WigStyle and every card links only to /styles/{styleId}.
failure_example: A future length/colour-specific result cannot encode its matched variant in the URL.
customer_effect: Landing opens with no option selected; the customer must reconstruct the match.
financial_effect: Potential selection abandonment; no incorrect charge occurs before selection.
required_future_contract: A future result contract must carry selected variant identity or explicit option state through landing.

current_behavior: VariantSelector state starts with color/length/curl all null and is client-local; no search parameter or route segment selects a variant.
failure_example: A link intended for a specific SKU lands on an unselected style.
customer_effect: Matched option is not highlighted or guaranteed to be reachable from the presented result.
financial_effect: Could cause purchase of a different option after manual reselection.
current_test_evidence: Pure selector tests cover combinations but no inbound selection contract.
required_future_contract: Variant landing must resolve one exact variant and fail visibly if that variant is unavailable.

current_behavior: Style card shows the minimum priced active variant with a '~'; detail initially selects none.
failure_example: A style result visually associated with one option can advertise another option's lower minimum price.
customer_effect: Price expectation may not match the option the customer intended.
financial_effect: No snapshot error once selected; preselection expectation risk remains.
current_test_evidence: Catalog integration test proves minimum-price behavior.
required_future_contract: Any option-specific result must display that variant's market price and land on the same variant.

current_behavior: CartItem stores independent wigStyleId and variantId FKs; addToCart validates variant existence/price/stock but not that the variant belongs to the supplied style.
failure_example: Caller submits variant from style B with wigStyleId of style A.
customer_effect: Cart can show style A name/cover beside style B color/length/curl.
financial_effect: Checkout prices the variant, so amount remains variant-derived, but the customer can pay for a product identity different from cart presentation.
required_future_contract: Cart insertion must have one canonical parent derivation or a tested coherence invariant.

current_behavior: Cart display reads CartItem.style plus CartItem.variant; checkout ignores CartItem.wigStyleId and snapshots variant.wigStyle.
failure_example: A mismatched CartItem changes style identity between cart and checkout/session snapshot.
customer_effect: Presented product name/cover can change at checkout.
financial_effect: Unit amount stays tied to variant market price; identity surprise can still cause financial harm.
current_test_evidence: Tests prove price alignment only for coherent fixtures.
required_future_contract: Cart and checkout must consume the same canonical style/variant identity.

current_behavior: Session and order retain variantId, unitAmount, fulfillment, and copied display snapshot; snapshot omits SKU and style ID.
failure_example: SKU later changes and historical snapshot cannot show the purchased SKU text.
customer_effect: Variant DB ID remains, but a human-readable exact identifier is not frozen.
financial_effect: Price is frozen correctly; support/dispute identification may be weaker.
current_test_evidence: Session tests prove snapshot fields and price immutability.
required_future_contract: Decide whether exact offer/SKU/spec identity must be part of the immutable snapshot.

current_behavior: Variants group only by their WigStyle parent; there is no cross-style family/series or offer-version relation.
failure_example: Two styles belonging to one commercial family cannot be grouped structurally.
customer_effect: Discovery cannot distinguish sibling variants from related separate styles.
required_future_contract: Future discovery must define whether WigStyle is the complete family boundary.

current_behavior: A published style may contain active variants without a market price; listing remains visible with null/min price and detail disables unpriced selection purchase.
failure_example: Admin activates a style market and receives warnings but no block.
customer_effect: Customer can reach a published style whose desired option lacks a price.
financial_effect: Checkout/add-to-cart fail closed, so no incorrect charge; conversion dead end remains.
current_test_evidence: Market-price tests cover warning and null price behavior.
required_future_contract: Future result eligibility must state whether unpriced variants participate in discovery.
